$comment: S1/S2 facts only (research-manager, 2026-08-16). Remaining TODOs are S3/Gate-1 material. READ derivation/sources.md FIRST: (a) ⚑ AI-900 was RETIRED 2026-06-30 and replaced by AI-901 — whether this package proceeds at all is a Gate-1 decision, not a pipeline one; (b) Microsoft publishes domain weights as RANGES (15-20/15-20/15-20/15-20/20-25), which sum to 80-105, never to 100 — the weight_pct values here are DERIVED, not vendor-stated: range midpoints (17.5/17.5/17.5/17.5/22.5, sum 92.5) normalised to 100 and rounded to the tie-free allocation 19/19/19/19/24. Gate 1 must ratify that normalisation; (c) exam.item_count is NOT published per exam — Microsoft states only that most exams 'typically contain between 40-60 questions', so the count is a documented choice (band midpoint 50 recommended) left TODO rather than invented; (d) pass_threshold_pct has no honest raw-percentage value — the real exam is scaled 1-1,000 with a 700 pass mark that Microsoft says 'may not equal 70% of the points', and multi-part items earn partial credit, so any percentage here is a disclosed proxy. time_limit_minutes 45 IS a hard vendor fact (Fundamentals exam type; 65 min seat time).
